title: terraform-aws-salesforce-event-relay: Salesforce Event Relay on Amazon EventBridge and SQS
description: A production-oriented Terraform module that receives Salesforce Platform Events and Change Data Capture events through the native Salesforce Event Relay integration with Amazon EventBridge. It associates a Salesforce partner event source, filters events, delivers them to an encrypted durable SQS queue, preserves failures in separate dead-letter queues, archives events for replay, and provisions operational CloudWatch metrics and alarms.
